lines: Mari
E-Ehh...? Uhm... a-and you are...?
Mari timidly asked the woman who had suddenly appeared.
She had thought that the woman might be one of the Red Oni's allies, but that didn't seem to be the case. And more importantly, her combat suitー
Monster
『ーShinganji Kurenai. She's a Taimanin, just like you.』
Mari
I-I knew it!!! Wait, did you say Shinganji...?
The name sounded familiar to Mari, reminding her of the prestigious Shinganji Family that was once considered one of the "Eight Generals of the Fuma."
But it was said that they had broken away from Gosha during the rebellion of Fuma Danjo and stepped down from their position.
Kurenai
You know me...? That means you must be a Taimanin from Gosha.
Mari
Y-Yes!! I'm Shinohara Mari.
Mari
I'm a Taimanin... but still a student in training.
Kurenai
I see. Even so, it's quite impressive that a student like you knows my name.
Mari
Ah, that's because... my classmate Fuma-kun has mentioned it before...
Kurenai
What!? You're his friend!?
Mari
Eh?
Shinganji Kurenai had latched onto a strange point.
Kurenai
Ah!? N-No, I just... When you say "Fuma-kun of Gosha Academy", you mean Kotaro, don't you?
Mari
That's right, Fuma Kotaro-kun. We're not really friends, but I've talked to him a few times...
Mari
(I mean, I can't really say that I've been secretly observing him...)
He had accomplished a number of missions with his Independent Commando Unit, plus Headmistress Asagi and the other grown-up Taimanin had acknowledged his skills.
For Mari, who had been stuck as a trainee without being able to unleash her potential, Kotaro was something like a role model.
Mari
...What about you, Kurenai-san, are you friends with Fuma-kun?
Kurenai
Hm? Y-, yeah, I guess... I've known him since I was a kid...
Was she embarrassed? It was obvious that she was trying to appear calm and collected when she answered.
Mari
(Hmm? I thought she was scary... but maybe she's not?)
When she had first shown up, Kurenai had given Mari the impression of a sharp blade,
but as soon as Fuma Kotaro was mentioned, the edge of her intimidating aura magically melted away.
Kurenai
A-Anyways!!! This is not the right time to talk about that!
Mari
(Ah, the scary look's back!)
With her original ice-cold gaze, Kurenai glared at the cowering monster.
Monster
『Hehe, is that so? I would not mind it at all if you were to continue your amusing conversation.』
Kurenai
Shut up, you peeping tom. ーShinohara Mari, if you are a Taimanin then that speeds things up.
Kurenai
I don't know what you two have been doing together, but this monster is an extremely dangerous being.
Mari
D-Dangerous...!?
Mari had almost forgotten, but when Kurenai had shown up earlier, she had stared at the monster with cold hostility.
Kurenai
Yes. He's commonly known as the "Book Djinn." He's a demonic being who brings ruin in exchange for people's wishes.
Mari
Book Djinn
Astonished by Kurenai's words, Mari turned to look at the creature.
This monsterーthe "Book Djinn" was holding a large open wound on his body, his breathing painfully ragged.
Mari
Wh-What... does that mean...?
Kurenai
Well, it means exactly what I said.
Kurenai coldly answered the question the trembling Mari had posed.
Kurenai
He grants wishes to the person he has made a contract with by using the enormous demonic power he has within him... And not only that...
Kurenai
but once he has granted the wish, he will inflict ruin much greater than the original wish to the person who made it.
Mari
Ruin...?
Kurenai
Yes. Those contracted with him will lose their wealth, their glory, anything they've earned... and even their loved ones and family will be taken from them.
Kurenai
...To lose something you have earned is much more painful than not having it in the first place.
Kurenai
This guy is the worst kind of fiend who enjoys watching people despair.
Book Djinn
Mari
That... can't be...
Mari muttered in shock.
On the other hand, the djinn's lips were drawn tight, simply taking the brunt of Kurenai's harsh words.
Kurenai
And soーa certain someone contacted me.
Kurenai
I won't go into the details, but... just think of me as a freelance Taimanin who deals with demonic threats separately from Gosha.
Kurenai
And... my job this time is to seal away this djinn.
As the icy words left Kurenai's mouth, she raised her kodachi in both hands to point them at the djinn.
Mari
To seal him away...
Kurenai
Yes, and that's why I need you to help me.
Kurenai
There are multiple organizations after this guy's enormous demonic power. So I want to get this over with before things get complicated.
Mari
D-Did you... make those wounds on his body, Kurenai-san...?
Kurenai
I did. I almost had him earlier... but was interrupted by the Kuron-kai or whatever they're called.
Kurenai
They seem to have hired a lot of mercenaries. I'm sure they're still searching this area.
Mari
(She must mean that Red Oni...)
Mari recalled the Red Oni who had been beating the djinn in the back ally.
...But somehow Mari still wasn't convinced.
Mari
...Djinn-san, is it true what she said?
Book Djinn
『...Mari?』
The djinn raised his head and looked at Mari.
Mari
What Kurenai-san just said. Are you really... that bad of a person?
Book Djinn
『...Would you believe me if I said "no?"』
Kurenai
Hmm?
Kurenai narrowed her eyes as if she was interested in what the djinn had to say.
Mari
...Please explain everything to us. I want to hear what you have to say, Djinn-san.
Book Djinn
A moment of silence. Then the djinn spoke as if he had made up his mindー
Book Djinn
『It is true that I have the power to grant people's wishes and to lead them to their ruin. ...But that is not what I desire.』
Book Djinn
『It is the sorcerer who created me who wished for this powerー』
Onceー
Several hundred years ago, a certain sorcerer created a djinn.
The role of the djinn was to "fulfill the wishes of those he contracted with" by using his great demonic power.
However, there was a curse attached to this power.
It was the curse of the sorcerer, the djinn's creator, who resented the human world and wished to drown it in misery.
And so those who had their wishes fulfilled by the power of the djinn would be met with even greater misfortuneー
Book Djinn
『I became aware of this curse only after witnessing the fates of those whose wishes I granted.』
Book Djinn
『And I... came to loathe my own power.』
He thought he had been created to grant people's wishes.
And yet, the lives of all those he had helped had been cruelly ruinedー
Book Djinn
『That is why I decided to seal away my power of my own volition... But, even that wasn't allowed.』
When the sorcerer was on his deathbed, he leaked certain information into the underworld...
Rumors about the existence of a djinn who could grant any wish, as well as the secret spell to bind his will.
Those rumors turned the djinn into the target of avarice in the blink of an eye.
Even without his demonic power, the very existence of the djinn was enough to cause people to fight, maim each other, and fall into disaster.
...As had been occurring for hundreds of years.
And now, in front of the djinn who had seen the unending ruin of countless people, Taimanin Shinganji Kurenai had appeared.
Kurenai
ーIt's not your desire? I don't believe you. That's how any monster tries to deceive people.
Even after the djinn had finished speaking, Kurenai's expression was still cold.
Book Djinn
『You're right... I did not expect you to believe me either. Besides, it no longer matters if I did or not.』
Kurenai
Hmm...?
Kurenai's gaze turned towards the djinn's body.
A deep, open woundーThe demonic energy leaking from there was sadly weak.
Kurenai
You're a shell of your former self. it looks like you used too much of your demonic power, huh?
Book Djinn
The djinn only nodded silently as if to accept his hopeless situation.
He wasn't even able to close the wounds dealt by Kurenai.
After hundreds of years, he had exhausted his demonic power and could fade away at any moment.
Mari
Uhmm, excuse me...?
Mari had been watching the two of them timidly.
She had many things she wanted to say, but wasn't able to put them into wordsー At that moment...
Thug
There you are, you rotten djinn!!! So this is where you've been hiding!
Mari
Uwaah!? Wh-Who are those people...?
Kurenai
The Kuron-kaiーthe group that was after the djinn had caught up to them.
